biggest_catch: Listings skew toward full-time roles at major companies — a competitive hiring funnel, not a gig marketplace.
catches: Most listings are full-time roles, not quick freelance gigs — longer hiring cycles.
High-profile employers mean intense competition; most applications win nothing.
Pay is set per listing by each employer — Authentic Jobs publishes no fixed pay range.
No platform escrow — payment is between you and the hiring company.

c1.evidence: Authentic Jobs is a live, provider-owned job board (authenticjobs.com) with current listings from major employers — designers, developers, and creative pros browse and apply directly — a real, public deal-sourcing channel.

c2.evidence: Official pages publish no fixed pay range — pay is set per listing; framed as variable.

c3.evidence: Steps follow the platform flow: browse listings, filter, apply to employers directly, interview, hired per employer terms.

c4.evidence: Browsing and applying carries no upfront fee.

eligibility: Designers, developers, and creative professionals who can match listed role requirements.
notes: Scenario: design/dev jobs board. Authentic Jobs is a long-running job board for designers, hackers, and creative pros with live listings (including contract/remote roles) — a standing deal source. Pay is per-listing and variable — never guaranteed.
